ABOUT POWER-UP TALENT

People at the heart.
Progress in mind.

A specialist talent, development and commercial intelligence partner for businesses across technical distribution, engineering, manufacturing, construction and facilities management.

WHY WE DO WHAT WE DO

Built for the businesses
that keep Britain moving.

Technical distribution, wholesale, engineering and contracting form the vital backbone of the UK economy. Yet for years, these sectors have been treated by generic recruitment agencies as transactional volume feeds.

We created Power-Up Talent to fundamentally challenge and change that model. We do what we do because we believe high-consequence technical businesses deserve a commercial growth partner who truly understands trade counter dynamics, regional rebate pressures, and the critical importance of branch-level leadership.

We do not treat talent as commodities or trade away your margins. Our mission is to build lasting team capability, protect gross margins, and empower the people who drive British industrial commerce.

WHY WE MAKE A DIFFERENCE

A fundamentally different
commercial standard.

Three structural commitments that set Power-Up Talent apart from conventional transactional recruitment agencies.

01

Radical Single-Client Loyalty

We never play both sides of the street. Traditional recruiters place someone with you today, then recruit for your direct competitor down the road tomorrow. Under our strict single-client territory policy, our search and intelligence assets are dedicated exclusively to your market leadership.

  • Guaranteed non-compete in your sector & region
  • Zero conflict of interest across client accounts
  • Strict protection of your existing workforce
02

Commercial Context Over Keywords

A successful appointment requires far more than matching keywords on a CV. We evaluate candidates against commercial track record, gross margin awareness, trade rebate pressure, and cultural grit within your territory.

  • In-depth candidate DNA profiling
  • Track record of margin defence and price discipline
  • Cultural and leadership fit assessment
03

One Connected Growth Engine

Recruitment in isolation leaves long-term value on the table. We fuse executive headhunting with 12-month performance coaching and live Companies House market intelligence, ensuring talent stays, integrates, and delivers measurable ROI.

  • 12-month commercial coaching sprints
  • Trade desk routine reinforcement
  • Live Companies House market whitespace mapping

OUR CULTURE & CORE VALUES

What we stand for.
How we operate.

The operating creed that guides every executive conversation, client partnership, and candidate engagement.

01 / INTEGRITY

Uncompromising Honesty

We provide direct, unvarnished commercial advice. If a candidate is not the right fit, or if your territory plan has blind spots, we tell you the truth rather than chasing a quick fee.

  • Zero placement-driven bias
  • Transparent communication at every stage
  • Strict bilateral NDA confidentiality
02 / GRIT

Trade Counter Respect

We respect the hard-working reality of trade counters, manufacturing plants, and engineering sites. We speak your language and operate without corporate jargon or empty buzzwords.

  • Decades of genuine sector immersion
  • Real appreciation of branch margin pressures
  • Practical solutions built for the day job
03 / PARTNERSHIP

Long-Term Capability

We measure our success not by placement volume, but by your EBITDA expansion, team retention, and market share growth over years of collaboration.

  • Single-client territory dedication
  • Post-placement coaching support
  • Aligned commercial outcomes

HUMAN JUDGEMENT FIRST

Technology informs.
People decide.

In an era of automated recruitment algorithms, we believe the highest-consequence decisions demand seasoned human insight.

01

Deep Sector Understanding

Informed research, relevant commercial questioning, and deep respect for the daily pressures on technical commercial teams.

  • Specialist industry immersion
  • Regional territory awareness
  • Commercial context mapping
02

Discretion & Dignity

Professional, respectful conversations that protect client strategy and candidate career confidentiality at every step.

03

Human-Governed Intelligence
